name: desktop-web-client
description: Desktop & Web application built with React, TypeScript, Vite and Electron

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -s first "npm run dev" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run compile:electron && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run compile:electron && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build && npm run compile:electron && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build && npm run compile:electron && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build && npm run compile:electron && electron-builder --linux
